youtube_title: Fake QR Sticker at the Petrol Pump: Check the Amount or the Name? Scam of the Week #5 #Shorts
youtube_description:
SCAM OF THE WEEK #5. You scan the QR at a petrol pump and pay, but the owner says the money never came. Someone pasted their own QR over the real one - this happened at petrol pumps and shops in Khajuraho and Chhatarpur, Madhya Pradesh, in January 2025.
Before you pay, what do you check? A: the amount. B: the payee name.
Answer: B. NPCI's tip: always check the recipient's name on screen before sending money. Not the shop's name? Stop. If a QR looks pasted on, ask the staff. Scammed? Call 1930 or report on cybercrime.gov.in.
Sources: NPCI safety tips (July 2025); India Today report on the MP QR swap (Jan 2025).

Petrol bharwaya, QR scan kiya, paise kat gaye… par pump ko ₹0 mila 😳 Kisi ne asli QR ke upar apna QR chipka diya tha — MP mein petrol pumps aur shops pe sach mein hua.
Pay se pehle kya check karoge? A: amount. B: payee ka naam.
Sahi hai B — NPCI: paise bhejne se pehle screen pe receiver ka naam check karo. Shop ka naam nahi? Ruk jao. QR chipka hua lage toh poochho. Fraud? 1930.
